question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"marijuena"** is incorrectly spelt.

 
 
• Correct spelling: **marijuana** (गांजा)
 
• **English Meaning:** A psychoactive drug from the Cannabis plant used primarily for medical or recreational purposes.
 
• **Example: **The use of marijuana for medicinal purposes is becoming more accepted worldwide.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Stationery **(स्टेशनरी): Writing and other office materials.

 
 
• **Example:** She bought new stationery for her office work.
 
 
 
• **Lascivious **(कामुक): Feeling or revealing an overt sexual interest or desire.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie was criticized for its lascivious content.
 
 
 
• **Dictator **(तानाशाह): A ruler with total power over a country, typically one who has obtained power by force.
 
 
• **Example:** The dictator ruled the country with an iron fist.
